# Psalm 140 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 140:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-have-said to-YHWH, 'My-God you-are'; give-ear O-YHWH to-voice-of my-supplications.
- **LOGOS:** I say to the LORD, You are my God; give ear to the voice of my pleas for mercy, O LORD!
- **PNEUMA:** I say to the LORD, 'You are my God!' Listen to my cries for help, LORD!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 140:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-head-of those-surrounding-me, the-mischief-of their-lips let-cover-them.
- **LOGOS:** As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their lips overwhelm them!
- **PNEUMA:** Let the trouble they've caused come back on their own heads!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 140:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-man-of tongue not let-be-established in-the-land; a-man-of violence — evil let-it-hunt-him thrust-upon-thrust.
- **LOGOS:** Let not the slanderer be established in the land; let evil hunt down the violent man speedily!
- **PNEUMA:** Don't let slanderers gain a foothold in the land; let disaster hunt down the violent and finish them off.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 140:12 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-know that will-do YHWH the-cause-of the-afflicted, the-justice-of the-needy.
- **LOGOS:** I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and will execute justice for the needy.
- **PNEUMA:** I know the LORD will champion the cause of the poor and bring justice to the needy.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 140:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Surely the-righteous will-give-thanks to-your-name; will-dwell the-upright before-your-face.
- **LOGOS:** Surely the righteous shall give thanks to your name; the upright shall dwell in your presence.
- **PNEUMA:** The righteous will certainly praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 140:4 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Keep-me O-YHWH from-hands-of the-wicked; from-man-of violence preserve-me, who have-planned to-trip my-steps.
- **LOGOS:** Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from violent men, who have planned to trip up my feet.
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, keep me safe from the wicked! Protect me from violent people who plan to trip me up.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
